senses.zh_definition: 佩姬：英语女性人名，传统上是 Margaret 的昵称。这里只提供可核实的人名用法，无法据此确定输入词项的实际所指。
senses.en_definition: Peggy: an English feminine given name, traditionally a familiar form of Margaret; not a verified Malay common noun.
senses.ms_definition: Peggy ialah nama khas perempuan dalam bahasa Inggeris yang secara tradisional merupakan nama panggilan bagi Margaret; ini bukan takrif rasmi DBP.
senses.nuances: 本次未核实其为标准马来语词头，因此 status 不标为 official。作为人名应写 Peggy。以下短语和情景仅示范人名嵌入马来语句子的方式，不代表高频词汇搭配，也不指认任何真实人物。人名关系依据：[Dictionary of Medieval Names from European Sources](https://dmnes.wordpress.com/2017/01/25/how-do-you-get-peggy-from-margaret/)。

etymology.historical_story: Peggy belongs to English naming history rather than an established Malay derivational family. Research on medieval names traces Margaret through shortened forms such as Mag and Meg, with Peg arising through rhyming substitution. Peggy developed within that naming tradition. This explains an English personal name, but does not identify the intended referent of the supplied lowercase token. [DMNES](https://dmnes.wordpress.com/2017/01/25/how-do-you-get-peggy-from-margaret/).
